hook.name: EthCreatorFeeHookV3
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native ETH/token pools that charges configurable directional buy/sell fees (1%–10% in 1% steps), splitting proceeds between a creator reward vault and an immutable launcher fee recipient. Fees are collected via BeforeSwapDelta and afterSwap delta returns; pools must be pre-registered by the token creator before they can be initialized or traded.
